title.en: An Act Establishing the San Isidro National High School in the Municipality of Bacon, Province of Sorsogon, and Providing Funds Therefor

text.en: There shall be a national high school in Barangay San Isidro, Municipality of Bacon, Province of Sorsogon, under the direct supervision of the Department of Education, Culture and Sports.
The amount necessary to carry out the provisions of this Act shall be included in the General Appropriations Act of the year following its enactment into law and thereafter.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
